name: dsh-factory
description: Durable dependency-graph task factory for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && tsc -b tsconfig.host.json tsconfig.client.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --pretty false
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter dsh-factory-protocol run build && pnpm --filter dsh-factory-store run build && pnpm --filter dsh-factory-store-sqlite run build && pnpm --filter dsh-factory-tools run build && pnpm --filter dsh-factory-domain run build && pnpm --filter dsh-factory-scheduler run build && pnpm --filter dsh-factory-client-ui run build
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
